I am about to finish cleaning up the refactor #42816 of the messy file CategoryTheory/Limits/Presheaf.lean. While doing so, I have noticed that certain lemmas cannot be made simp lemmas because simp does not seem to be able to use them unless an explicit universe parameter is provided (even though that universe appears in the term we want to rewrite).
For example, at https://github.com/joelriou/mathlib4/blob/e7df0dbdd297a75cdf062447dfb71c3ed87f96e4/Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Functor/KanExtension/DenseAtCoyoneda.lean#L47 it would not work if the universe w was not given for the lemma shrinkCoyonedaEquiv_symm_map.
Is this a bug which may be fixed?
